title.en: Malay Annals: the 1821 English title page

alt.en: Printed title page naming Malay Annals, translator John Leyden and introducer Stamford Raffles, with London and 1821 below.
alt.zh: 印刷扉页题为《马来纪年》，列出译者约翰·莱登与序言作者斯坦福·莱佛士，下方标注伦敦和1821年。

caption.en: Title page of John Leyden’s English translation, with an introduction by Stamford Raffles. London: Longman, Hurst, Rees, Orme, and Brown, 1821. Wellcome Collection, EPB/B/47949.
caption.zh: 约翰·莱登英译本扉页，斯坦福·莱佛士作序。伦敦Longman、Hurst、Rees、Orme与Brown出版，1821年。惠康收藏馆，EPB/B/47949。

interpretation.en: The page names the translator and introducer prominently. It shows how a Malay court text reached an English-reading audience two centuries after the Johor compilation, not the original 1612 manuscript.
interpretation.zh: 扉页突出列出译者与序言作者姓名。它显示柔佛编纂约两百年后，马来宫廷文本如何进入英语读者的视野，并非1612年的原始手稿。

title.en: Truyện Kiều: an illustrated manuscript opening

alt.en: Manuscript opening with large title characters above three figures beside a tree, handwritten notes at the top and a red library stamp below.
alt.zh: 抄本卷首以大字题名，下绘树旁三个人物；页顶有手写批注，下方盖有红色图书馆印章。

caption.en: Opening page, fol. 1r, of an illustrated copy of Nguyễn Du’s Truyện Kiều. The British Library dates the manuscript to the second half of the nineteenth century. Or 14844.
caption.zh: 阮攸《金云翘传》绘图抄本卷首，第1叶正面。大英图书馆将此抄本定为19世纪后半叶，馆藏编号Or 14844。

interpretation.en: Title, drawn figures and later annotations occupy the same page. The surviving copy makes the poem’s circulation visible after Nguyễn Du’s death; its figures belong to the illustrated story, not a portrait of the poet.
interpretation.zh: 题名、绘制的人物与后加批注共存于一页。存世抄本呈现阮攸去世后诗作的流传；图中人物属于故事插图，并非诗人肖像。

items.creator: Nguyễn Du, text; copyist and illustrator unrecorded

context.en: An 1821 English edition of the work associated with Tun Sri Lanang’s compilation and editing; not his handwriting or portrait.
context.zh: 与敦斯里拉囊编纂、整理相关作品的1821年英译本，并非其亲笔或肖像。
